field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=예방; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0492

en: The teacher spoke so fast that I couldn't really understand.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=알아듣다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0493

de: Viele koreanische Wörter gehen auf chinesische Schriftzeichen zurück.
en: Many Korean words come from Chinese characters.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=한자; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0494

ko: 저는 읽기는 괜찮은데 듣기가 아직 어려워요.
de: Lesen klappt bei mir ganz gut, aber Hören fällt mir noch schwer.
en: Reading is fine for me, but listening is still hard.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=읽기; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0495

ko: 오늘 한국어 쓰기 숙제로 일기를 썼어요.

field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=쓰기; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0496

de: Lena, dein Koreanisch ist echt viel besser geworden!
en: Lena, your Korean has really improved a lot!
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=한국말; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0497

ko: 오랫동안 청소를 안 해서 책상 위에 먼지가 많아요.
de: Ich habe lange nicht geputzt, deshalb liegt viel Staub auf dem Schreibtisch.
en: I haven't cleaned in a long time, so there's a lot of dust on the desk.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=먼지; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0498

ko: 바닥이 더러워서 걸레로 깨끗하게 닦았어요.
de: Der Boden war schmutzig, deshalb habe ich ihn mit dem Lappen gewischt.
en: The floor was dirty, so I wiped it clean with a rag.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=걸레; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0499

ko: 빨래할 때 세제를 조금만 넣어도 깨끗해져요.
de: Beim Waschen wird die Wäsche schon mit wenig Waschmittel sauber.
en: When you do laundry, even a little detergent gets things clean.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=세제; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0500

ko: 다리미가 아직 뜨거우니까 만지지 마세요.
de: Fassen Sie das Bügeleisen nicht an, es ist noch heiß.
en: Don't touch the iron, it's still hot.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=다리미; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0501

ko: 아침에 햇빛이 너무 강해서 커튼을 쳤어요.
de: Morgens war die Sonne so grell, dass ich die Vorhänge zugezogen habe.
en: The morning sun was so bright that I closed the curtains.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=커튼; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0502

ko: 저는 베란다에서 토마토를 키워요.
de: Ich ziehe auf dem Balkon Tomaten.
en: I grow tomatoes on the balcony.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=베란다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0503

ko: 밥이 식어서 전자레인지에 1분 정도 돌렸어요.
de: Der Reis war kalt, also habe ich ihn etwa eine Minute in die Mikrowelle gestellt.
en: The rice had gone cold, so I microwaved it for about a minute.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=전자레인지; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0504

ko: 봉지는 괜찮아요. 그냥 가방에 넣어 갈게요.
de: Ich brauche keine Tüte. Ich packe es einfach in meine Tasche.
en: I don't need a plastic bag. I'll just put it in my own bag.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=봉지; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0505

ko: 회사 근처 식당이 비싸서 요즘 도시락을 싸 가요.
de: Die Restaurants bei der Firma sind teuer, deshalb nehme ich mir zurzeit Essen mit.
en: The restaurants near work are expensive, so these days I bring a packed lunch.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=도시락; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0506

ko: 잠깐 볼일이 있어서 은행에 다녀올게요.

en: I have a quick errand, so I'll pop over to the bank.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=볼일; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0507

ko: 휴대폰 배터리가 다 돼서 전화를 못 받았어요.
de: Mein Handyakku war leer, deshalb konnte ich nicht rangehen.
en: My phone battery died, so I couldn't answer the call.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=배터리; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0508

ko: 새로 산 세탁기 사용법을 잘 모르겠어요.
de: Ich weiß nicht so recht, wie die neue Waschmaschine funktioniert.
en: I'm not really sure how to use the new washing machine.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=사용법; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0509

ko: 돈을 아끼려고 요즘 집에서 밥을 해 먹어요.
de: Um Geld zu sparen, koche ich zurzeit zu Hause.
en: I've been cooking at home lately to save money.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=아끼다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0510

en: Christian, could you help me carry this box?
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=옮기다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0511

ko: 집에서 나갈 때 문을 꼭 잠가 주세요.
de: Bitte schließen Sie die Tür ab, wenn Sie aus dem Haus gehen.
en: Please make sure to lock the door when you leave the house.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=잠그다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0512

ko: 날씨가 좋아서 베란다에 빨래를 널었어요.

en: The weather was nice, so I hung laundry on the balcony.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=널다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0513

ko: 아침에 급하게 나가다가 커피를 쏟았어요.

en: I spilled my coffee while rushing out this morning.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=쏟다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0514

field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=묶다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0516

ko: 밤에는 추워서 두꺼운 이불을 덮고 자요.

field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=덮다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0517

field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=채우다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0518

field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=밀리다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0519

ko: 늦잠을 자서 버스를 놓쳤어요.

field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=놓치다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0520

ko: 집 앞에 세워 둔 자전거가 사라졌어요.

en: The bike I'd left in front of the house has disappeared.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=사라지다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0521

de: Ich habe mich so gut vorbereitet und bin trotzdem durchgefallen, ich bin total geknickt.
en: I prepared so hard and still failed the exam, so I'm really upset.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=속상하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0522

ko: 벌써 여행이 끝나서 정말 아쉬워요.
de: Wirklich schade, dass die Reise schon vorbei ist.
en: It's a real shame the trip is already over.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=아쉽다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0523

ko: 사람들 앞에서 넘어져서 너무 창피했어요.

en: I fell over in front of everyone, and it was so embarrassing.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=창피; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0524

en: I had high hopes, but the result was bad, so I was disappointed.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=실망; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0525

ko: 아이한테서 잘 도착했다고 문자가 와서 안심했어요.
de: Mein Kind hat geschrieben, dass es gut angekommen ist, da war ich erleichtert.
en: My kid texted that they'd arrived safely, so I felt relieved.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=안심; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0526

ko: 지갑을 잃어버렸는데 다행히 누가 경찰서에 맡겨 줬어요.
de: Ich hatte meinen Geldbeutel verloren, aber zum Glück hat ihn jemand bei der Polizei abgegeben.
en: I lost my wallet, but luckily someone handed it in to the police.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=다행히; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0527

de: Als Kind hat mich meine Mutter oft ausgeschimpft, weil ich mich mit meinem Bruder gestritten habe.
en: As a kid, I often got scolded by my mom for fighting with my brother.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=혼나다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0528

ko: 동생은 제가 해외에서 공부하는 걸 많이 부러워해요.
de: Mein jüngerer Bruder beneidet mich sehr darum, dass ich im Ausland studiere.
en: My younger brother really envies me for studying abroad.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=부러워하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0529

en: A customer complained that the food came out late.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=불만; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0530

ko: 저는 어려운 사람을 늘 돕는 할머니를 존경해요.
de: Ich habe großen Respekt vor meiner Oma, weil sie immer Bedürftigen hilft.
en: I respect my grandmother, who always helps people in need.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=존경; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0531

ko: 앞으로도 우리 우정이 변하지 않았으면 좋겠어요.
de: Ich hoffe, dass sich unsere Freundschaft auch in Zukunft nicht ändert.
en: I hope our friendship never changes.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=우정; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0532

ko: 수진 씨, 진심으로 고마워요. 덕분에 이사를 잘 끝냈어요.
de: Sujin, ich danke dir von Herzen. Dank dir hat der Umzug gut geklappt.
en: Sujin, I'm truly grateful. Thanks to you, the move went smoothly.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=진심; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0533

ko: 이 약을 먹은 후부터 몸이 계속 가려워요.
de: Seit ich dieses Medikament nehme, juckt es mich am ganzen Körper.
en: Ever since I took this medicine, my body has been itching.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=가렵다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0534

ko: 잠을 못 자서 머리가 좀 어지러워요.
de: Ich habe nicht geschlafen, deshalb ist mir etwas schwindlig.
en: I didn't sleep, so I feel a bit dizzy.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=어지럽다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0535

ko: 어제 라면을 먹고 자서 얼굴이 많이 부었어요.
de: Ich habe gestern vor dem Schlafen Ramyeon gegessen, jetzt ist mein Gesicht ganz geschwollen.
en: I ate ramyeon right before bed last night, so my face is really puffy.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=붓다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0536

ko: 너무 피곤해서 아침에 코피가 났어요.
de: Ich war so müde, dass ich heute Morgen Nasenbluten hatte.
en: I was so tired that I got a nosebleed this morning.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=코피; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0537

ko: 버스를 오래 타면 멀미가 나요.
de: Wenn ich lange Bus fahre, wird mir schlecht.
en: I get carsick on long bus rides.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=멀미; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0538

ko: 점심을 너무 빨리 먹어서 체한 것 같아요.
de: Ich habe mittags zu schnell gegessen und habe wohl eine Magenverstimmung.
en: I ate lunch too fast, and I think I have indigestion.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=체하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0539

ko: 저녁을 많이 먹어서 소화가 잘 안 돼요.
de: Ich habe abends zu viel gegessen, jetzt liegt es mir schwer im Magen.
en: I ate a lot for dinner, and it's not digesting well.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=소화; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0540

ko: 어제 계단에서 넘어져서 발목을 다쳤어요.
de: Ich bin gestern die Treppe hinuntergefallen und habe mir den Knöchel verletzt.
en: I fell on the stairs yesterday and hurt my ankle.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=발목; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0541

ko: 요즘 일이 많아서 몸살이 났어요.
de: Ich hatte zurzeit so viel Arbeit, dass ich jetzt Gliederschmerzen habe.
en: I've had so much work lately that I've got body aches.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=몸살; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0542

ko: 독감 예방 주사를 맞으러 병원에 갔어요.
de: Ich bin zum Arzt gegangen, um mich gegen Grippe impfen zu lassen.
en: I went to the clinic to get a flu shot.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=독감; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0543

ko: 열이 계속 나서 병원에서 진찰을 받았어요.
de: Ich hatte immer noch Fieber, deshalb habe ich mich im Krankenhaus untersuchen lassen.
en: My fever wouldn't go away, so I got examined at the hospital.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=진찰; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0544

ko: 밤에 배가 너무 아파서 응급실에 갔어요.
de: Nachts hatte ich so starke Bauchschmerzen, dass ich in die Notaufnahme gegangen bin.
en: My stomach hurt so badly at night that I went to the emergency room.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=응급실; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0545

ko: 신발이 너무 낡아서 새로 하나 샀어요.
de: Meine Schuhe waren völlig abgelaufen, deshalb habe ich mir neue gekauft.
en: My shoes were really worn out, so I bought a new pair.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=낡다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0546

ko: 새로 이사한 방은 작지만 깔끔해서 마음에 들어요.
de: Mein neues Zimmer ist klein, aber ordentlich, das gefällt mir.
en: My new room is small but neat, and I like it.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=깔끔하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0547

ko: 동생 방이 너무 지저분해서 같이 청소했어요.

en: My younger brother's room was so messy that we cleaned it together.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=지저분하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0548

ko: 시장에서 산 생선이 정말 싱싱해요.
de: Der Fisch vom Markt ist wirklich frisch.
en: The fish I bought at the market is really fresh.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=싱싱하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0549

ko: 한국에 처음 왔을 때 모든 것이 낯설었어요.
de: Als ich zum ersten Mal nach Korea kam, war mir alles fremd.
en: When I first came to Korea, everything felt unfamiliar.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=낯설다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0550

ko: 한국에서는 밤늦게도 음식을 배달해 줘서 정말 신기했어요.
de: Ich fand es echt erstaunlich, dass man sich in Korea auch spätabends Essen liefern lassen kann.
en: I was really amazed that in Korea you can get food delivered even late at night.
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=신기하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0551

ko: 마야 씨, 오늘 입은 재킷 정말 멋지네요!
de: Maya, deine Jacke heute sieht echt toll aus!
en: Maya, the jacket you're wearing today looks really great!
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=멋지다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0552

de: Daniel, du läufst jeden Morgen zehn Kilometer? Echt beeindruckend!
en: Daniel, you run ten kilometers every morning? That's really impressive!
field_notes: rights: original_clean_room; vocabKo=대단하다; unit=(assigned at promotion); derived from vocab_b1_0553
